headline: CDL Hospitality Trusts Q3 Net Property Income Climbs 7.1% to $36.7 Million
summary: CDL Hospitality Trusts posted a 7.1% year-on-year rise in third-quarter net property income to $36.7 million, even as income from its Singapore assets slipped 1.6% to $21.5 million.
why: CDL Hospitality Trusts is a prominent Singapore-listed real estate investment trust providing exposure to regional hotel occupancy and tourism revenue.

impacts.name: CDL Hospitality Trusts
impacts.why: Overall portfolio revenue gains were partially offset by softer net earnings in Singapore domestic properties.
